purpose: Complete the official or primary-public locator layer for every source route declared by the fourteen macro-estate fan-out lanes without claiming that the underlying record universe has been acquired.
interpretation_boundary: A complete locator registry is not a complete source corpus. A portal, API, collection, archive, or request route proves only where bounded records can be sought.

routes.bounded_output: Agency-specific administrative decisions, orders, dockets, enforcement dispositions, and appeal rights.
routes.residual_fog: No single denominator spans agencies; unpublished, redacted, restricted, and superseded decisions require agency-specific custody.

routes.bounded_output: Agency AI use-case inventories, governance documents, risk classifications, retired uses, and responsible offices where published.
routes.residual_fog: Inventory formats and historical coverage vary; vendor, model, data, authorization, and contract joins remain.

routes.bounded_output: Agency-specific award instruments, modifications, milestone records, and public decision files.
routes.residual_fog: There is no universal public repository for complete award files; each program and contracting activity must be partitioned.

routes.authority: U.S. Office of Government Ethics and agency ethics offices
routes.bounded_output: Public financial disclosures, PTRs, ethics agreements, certifications, recusals, waivers, and divestiture certificates.
routes.residual_fog: OGE holds only part of the filer universe; agency-by-agency requests, six-year retention limits, and lawful-use attestations remain.

routes.bounded_output: Leadership rosters, biographies, organisation charts, appointment and departure dates, and archived versions.
routes.residual_fog: Current pages are not tenure-complete; acting service, reorganisations, and archived pages require explicit reconstruction.

routes.bounded_output: National procurement, grant, innovation, and defence-award records for the frozen cohort.
routes.residual_fog: Every ally uses different identifiers and disclosure systems; a country-by-country acquisition plan is required.

routes.bounded_output: Public appointments, terms, appointing authority, dates, remuneration, and declared interests where published.
routes.residual_fog: No single register covers all advisers, direct ministerial appointees, boards, and departments; nil returns and departures require partitioning.

routes.authority: GAO, inspectors general, state auditors, and program auditors
routes.bounded_output: Audit reports, findings, recommendations, questioned costs, corrective actions, and closure status.
routes.residual_fog: Coverage must be partitioned by program and auditor; absence from one portal is not a negative result.

routes.bounded_output: Authority annual reports, board rosters, budgets, property reports, procurement reports, and audits.
routes.residual_fog: Authority-by-authority coverage and historical documents require explicit partitioning.

routes.authority: U.S. Department of Commerce Bureau of Industry and Security
routes.bounded_output: Entity, denied-person, unverified and military end-user restrictions, export-control rules, licenses guidance, and enforcement instruments.
routes.residual_fog: List membership, license requirement, license outcome, and enforcement disposition are distinct; controlled-item classification remains transaction-specific.

routes.bounded_output: Agendas, minutes, resolutions, votes, attachments, attendance, and meeting identifiers.
routes.residual_fog: A board authorization is not an executed agreement; attachments and closed-session records may be incomplete.

routes.authority: Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board and issuers

routes.residual_fog: Bond proceeds, draws, reimbursements, issuer accounting, and project-level cash flows require issuer records and audits.

routes.bounded_output: Annual aggregate reports, public enforcement notices, regulations, mitigation guidance, presidential actions, and selected transaction material.
routes.residual_fog: Transaction-specific information is generally confidential; public records cannot produce a complete transaction denominator or prove no review.

routes.authority: Charity Commission for England and Wales

routes.bounded_output: Company numbers, officers, PSCs, filing history, charges, insolvency, and document identifiers.
